He grew up in California and became one of the top high-school basketball prospects in the country, playing at Prolific Prep and earning McDonald’s All-American honors. Instead of playing college basketball, Green became the first player to sign with the G League Ignite, where he averaged 17.9 points, 4.1 rebounds, and 2.8 assists per game. ([NBA][1]) Green was selected **2nd overall by the Houston Rockets in the 2021 NBA Draft** and was named to the **2021–22 All-Rookie First Team**. During his time in Houston, he became known for his ability to create his own shot, attack the basket, shoot from deep, and score in transition.
